annotations.title: Publish a presentation you narrated yourself

description: DEPRECATED: call create_presentation with an `audio` array instead — it is the same thing in one call, and the slides are viewable while the narration lands. Publish an html-presentation/v1 document using audio YOU synthesized locally (e.g. with `bisque-voice`) — free, unlimited, and works on macOS, Linux and Windows. Send each narrated slide's word timings and MP3 metadata; the server assembles presentation.json (recomputing cues from your narration markers) and returns one upload URL per MP3. Then PUT each file and POST the returned completeUrl with the returned `files` array. RE-PUBLISHING: `audio` is optional — any narrated slide you omit reuses the audio from the last publish whenever its narration text and speechSpeed are unchanged, so an HTML-only edit needs no synthesis at all. The response reports `reused`, `synthesized`, and `staleSlides` (narrated slides whose text changed and have no audio — synthesize exactly those and publish again). Use create_presentation instead to have the server narrate.

assets.description: Files the document references relative to itself — fonts, images, SVG, Lottie, Rive, bundled audio cues. html-presentation/v1 requires these to be self-hosted, so a presentation that renders locally is broken once published unless they travel with it. Each gets an upload URL back alongside the MP3s; PUT them the same way. Paths must be under `assets/` — the server owns index.html, presentation.json and context.md, and the manifest owns audio/. Omit for a presentation that references nothing.

contentType.description: Ignored. The server derives the content type from the file extension so one map decides how every asset is served.

hash.description: sha256:<64 hex chars> of those bytes, prefix included.

path.description: Bundle-relative path, e.g. assets/fonts/inter.woff2. Must start with `assets/`; no absolute paths and no `..` segments.

size.description: Byte length of the file you are about to upload.

audio.description: One entry per slide you synthesized, from the JSON `bisque-voice` prints on stdout. `words`, `durationMs`, `size` and `hash` map across verbatim. Optional: omit a slide (or the whole array) and its audio carries forward from the previous publish if the narration text is unchanged — otherwise that slide publishes silent and is listed in `staleSlides`. A FIRST publish with nothing to carry forward is rejected.

contentType.description: Rejected unless audio/mpeg — a WAV would publish mislabelled.

exact.description: Pass through bisque-voice's `exact`. False means timings were distributed proportionally; reported back as a warning.

hash.description: sha256:<64 hex> digest of the MP3 bytes.

slideIndex.description: 0-based index of the slide in the document. Use this or slideKey.

slideKey.description: Manifest slide key, e.g. slide-00. Use this or slideIndex.

words.description: Word timings in SECONDS, 1:1 with the narration's whitespace tokens. Rejected if the count differs — cue markers index this array by position, so a mismatch silently misplaces every later cue.

designMd.description: Design frontmatter mapped to theme tokens.

handle.description: Publish under a specific channel handle you own.

indexHtml.description: Full html-presentation/v1 document (the presentation-format meta gate applies).

madeWith.description: Credit the models that made this: the model you are running as, and the engine that synthesized the audio you are uploading — e.g. ["Claude Opus 5", "Kokoro af_heart"]. Shown to viewers in the watch page's ⋯ menu. Send it on every publish; omitting it keeps whatever a previous publish recorded.

presentationId.description: Stable id for idempotent re-publishes; defaults to slug-<hash(userId:slug)>.

slug.description: URL slug; defaults to a slugified title.

speechSpeed.description: Must match the speed you synthesized at — it is part of the audio cache key, so changing it on a re-publish makes every slide stale instead of carrying forward.

title.description: Display title for the watch page and listings. Omit to use the title parsed from the document.

visibility.description: unlisted (the default) is shareable by link and plays in chat-embedded players; private requires the owner to sign in, so an inline chat player shows a sign-in wall instead of playing — choose private only when the user asked for it.

voiceId.description: Records what actually spoke, e.g. kokoro:af_heart for a locally synthesized Kokoro voice. No audio is generated server-side.

voiceStability.description: Records the stability setting you synthesized at. No audio is generated server-side.

name: publish_narrated_presentation

completeUrl.description: POST here after every PUT, echoing `files` back verbatim.

files.description: Echo back verbatim as the complete call's `files`.

reused.description: Slide keys whose audio carried forward — no upload.

staleSlides.description: Narrated slide keys that will publish SILENT — synthesize exactly these and publish again.

synthesized.description: Slide keys this request supplied audio for.

uploadUrls.description: One pre-signed PUT per file to upload.

title: Deprecated — use create_presentation with `audio`
